design.source_policy: same restricted G7 metadata-copy admission; exclude all 72 sources and paths used in R1.11B and R1.12; 12 new sources per replay/gate/exam group
design.balanced_batch: 4 entities, 2 per label, each in the same 2 training forms; 8 rows
design.contrast: CE + .25*softplus(1-sum of opposite-label correct margins) + .05*same-entity squared margin difference
design.exam: original >=20/32 both forms, net >=4, zero parent-correct old losses, >=16 old parent-correct; additionally each exam form recall for each label >=.5 and rank AUC >=.7

limits: Synthetic balanced binary associations, not open generation or scientific knowledge
Fresh source hashes and template strings do not prove independent external blind exam or semantic disjointness
Fixed replay deliberately isolates acquisition; no claim of homeostasis improvement
Equal model-token budget, different sampling and additional scalar loss arithmetic
No weight export, promotion, production changes
